name: Scenario 4: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion & Deadlock
description: Critical database connection pool saturation. OpsMind recalls Redis & DB connection pool playbooks from opsmind-runbooks.

payload.message: Orders database connection pool saturated at 100% capacity. Deadlock detected on transaction table.
payload.raw_logs: FATAL 2026-11-05T13:10:00Z [orders-db-pool] ConnectionPoolTimeout: 0 available connections. 80 threads waiting on row lock.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: Long-running batch report held table lock without releasing connection pool handles
resolution.resolution_summary: Killed blocking batch transaction, scaled pool capacity to 100, and moved report query to read-replica
resolution.lessons_learned: Enforce strict query timeout limits and offload analytics queries to read-replicas.
